name: mathmodel
description: A stateless mathematical modeling coach for Codex: recover workflow context, run real experiments, verify evidence, and prepare papers.

interface.longDescription: MathModel adds question-scoped recovery, durable experiment jobs, change-impact analysis and isolated replay to the pinned Pro P0-P9 modeling workflow. A local evidence workspace exposes actual artifacts, validation failures and logs. Alpha release: engineering checks do not establish competition-paper quality.
